## initWasm() function

Initialize the WASM backend.

After calling this function, verification and authorization functions in `@attest-it/core` will transparently delegate to the Rust/WASM implementation instead of the TypeScript one.

Safe to call multiple times — subsequent calls are no-ops.


Promise&lt;void&gt;
